qualification.public_summary: The Alpha 0.0.87 / B188 development candidate passed four bounded NTSC DV captures on one Sony HVR-M15U setup, including 609.442 seconds of saved DV. This does not qualify the public download, full-tape endurance, induced-reset capture, or the unresolved device-disappearance cause.
qualification.architecture: Apple silicon (app arm64, driver arm64e); Intel unsupported
qualification.hardware_scope: Sony HVR-M15U, recorded NTSC DV, tested Apple adapter chain, PCI 11c1:5901
qualification.dv_playback: saved raw DV25 NTSC/PAL and transitions validated offline
qualification.distribution: Public download is ad-hoc signed, not notarized; SIP must be disabled. Developer ID, notarization and normal SIP-on distribution remain future work.
